findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a detached logger that discards log records
findings.body: FromContext returns NewTestLogger(), a fresh instance unrelated to the receiver. LoggerMiddleware now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so any test that injects a TestLogger into LoggerMiddleware and then asserts on that instance's InfoLogs (calls/message/context) will observe nothing: the log record is counted on the throwaway logger returned here. The fake should return the receiver (or a logger sharing the same Logs state) so tests can observe logs emitted through FromContext.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no test coverage for the moved contextual-logging behavior
findings.body: This PR moves responsibility for enriching the request context with endpoint/pluginId/dsName/dsUID/uname from MetricsMiddleware into the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware, and LoggerMiddleware now depends on that enrichment via logger.FromContext(ctx) instead of adding those fields itself. No test was added for ContextualLoggerMiddleware (there is no contextual_logger_middleware_test.go), and the renamed metrics test only verifies Prometheus metrics. If the new middleware is mis-ordered in CreateMiddlewares, fails to enrich the context, or drops a field, the 'Plugin Request Completed' log line silently loses plugin/endpoint/datasource/user context with no failing test.
